title: ranunculus sceleratus subsp. typicus
intro: Ranunculus sceleratus subsp. typicus, commonly known as Cursed Buttercup, is a plant species belonging to the Ranunculaceae family, characterized by its bright yellow flowers and edible leaves. The health benefits of Ranunculus sceleratus subsp. typicus include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as arthritis and digestive issues. Therapeutically, the plant is traditionally used to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, with its actions being attributed to its ability to stimulate sweating and promote detoxification. The bioactive constituents of Ranunculus sceleratus subsp. typicus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which may be responsible for its medicinal properties.
